summary: T04 first timed event resource verified complete: stable URL/UID mapping, GET returns valid canonical VCALENDAR with HEAD-matching headers, and ETag (SHA-256 of canonical content) rotates only on content change. All 9 integration + 6 unit tests pass, clippy clean, T04 files fmt-clean.
defects: tests/dst_check.rs (untracked scratch file, not part of T04) fails `cargo fmt --check`; all T04 files are fmt-clean
follow_up: dst_check.rs scratch file needs `cargo fmt` before any repo-wide fmt gate; not a T04 deliverable
important_context: Implementation was already present in the worktree; I verified it rather than authoring it. ETag is a strong tag = quoted SHA-256 hex of the serialized VCALENDAR. Resource identity is a per-(calendar_id,event_id) row in caldav_event_resources with unique (calendar_id,uid) and (calendar_id,resource_name). Only timed, non-recurring events are exposed (list_exposed_event_ids).
